matched_note.title: UPSC Daily Current Affairs & Editorial Analysis Strategy: The Hindu & Indian Express in 30 Minutes

drafted_comment:
The real issue most aspirants face is getting bogged down in 3-hour newspaper reading sessions. To make this analysis useful for Mains, you need to move beyond passive reading.

1. Map every news item to a GS syllabus keyword (Governance, Economy, or Society).
2. Extract three pillars for every topic: a Constitutional article, a hard statistic, and a specific committee report.
3. Stop making long notes; focus on ready-to-quote facts instead.
